sources.title: Macbeth, Act 1, Scene 3 - the prophecy on the heath

facts.claim: Macbeth, Act 1 Scene 3: three watchers greet Macbeth with titles he has not yet received, and the promise unsettles both his ambition and Banquo's caution.
Tonight's scene was adapted from Macbeth, first performed around 1606 and read here from the Folger Shakespeare edition.
